irregularities.title: 'Byron Young' is listed under conflicting clubs
irregularities.detail: Sources disagree about which club 'Byron Young' belongs to (LAR, PHI). This is usually an upstream data error (wrong club attached to a player record) and must be reviewed before the row is trusted. No club was assigned by guesswork.

irregularities.title: 42 player(s) have no official designation but do have an ESPN status
irregularities.detail: nfl.com printed a blank Game Status for these players (they practised without a designation), so this site renders them as ACTIVE and marks the designation as inferred. ESPN separately carries a news-derived status. This is a semantic difference between the two sources, NOT a data error, so it is reported once in aggregate rather than once per player.

irregularities.title: 17 reporter claim(s) contradicted by the official report
irregularities.detail: These claims are retained (not deleted) because a contradicted claim is the evidence that drives a reporter's score down. Examples: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz said QUESTIONABLE for Joey Porter Jr. (official: see link); RichEisenShow@sportsbots.xyz said OUT for Cooper Rush (official: see link); Josh Weinfuss said QUESTIONABLE for Jeremiyah Love (official: see link); Zach Gershman said QUESTIONABLE for Garrett Williams (official: see link); Daniel Flick said OUT for Michael Penix Jr. (official: see link)

irregularities.title: Beat writer Aaron Wilson is attributed across 3 clubs (HOU, BAL, MIA)
irregularities.detail: ESPN printed Aaron Wilson (KPRC 2 Houston) as the attribution on updates for multiple clubs. Local beat writers normally cover one club, so this is usually a shared-wire/aggregator attribution; it is kept as observed and flagged for manual review rather than reassigned by guesswork.
